about: The plant worlds the Ur-world's garden hosts (rust/ur-world, garden.rs), written by `cargo run -p ur-world --example garden -- --vectors ../vectors`. Each is a world of its own with a trial key made from the garden's seed and its name, public to everyone and never for anything real; the template is the plant vectors' own, signed by a trial key.

law.change: This world takes no change from outside: it grows by its rule and dials alone.
world: A plant begins as one tip at the origin, pointing up. A place is written (x, y): x grows to the right and y downward, as on a screen.

Each step, every tip that hasn't split as many times as the dials allow grows one branch in its direction, as long as the dial for branches says, and splits into two tips, turned 45 degrees to either side.
With no water, nothing grows. With light below 3, a tip may split only half as many times.
If the world has a pot, a branch whose end would fall outside it isn't grown. Without one, the world grows as far as the plant does.

branchLength.about: How far each branch reaches, in cells.

light.about: Light: below 3, a tip may split only half as many times.

maxDepth.about: How many times a tip may split.
